newsitem.title: CROATIA: Croatian money rates steady despite weaker demand.
newsitem.headline: Croatian money rates steady despite weaker demand.

text.p: Croatian money market rates remained unchanged on Wednesday despite slightly weaker demand for kuna funds, dealers said.
"The morning saw a good supply...with some 20 million kuna still left on offer," one dealer said.
She said some further demand was still expected after regular payments by the bank's clients drain accounts today.
Fresh borrowings totalled 28.7 million kuna, most of which were call money loans at a steady 10.5 percent granted by banks, and one loan from an insurer at nine percent.
One-week interbank deals were struck at 12 percent. One one-month loan was made to a savings bank at 16 percent.
